description: Maize whorl leaf with characteristic ragged feeding damage, frass, and active Spodoptera frugiperda caterpillar.
Bean trifoliate foliage with angular dark brown necrotic lesions delimited by leaf veins.
Potato leaf showing rapidly expanding water-soaked necrotic lesions with chlorotic halos.
Tomato leaf blade exhibiting circular brown target-board necrotic lesions with concentric rings.
Vibrant green vegetative maize leaves without foliar lesions, chlorosis, or insect feeding scars.
